name: Intrusion Trace Hunting
objective: Reconstruct an evidence-backed adversary path from the earliest observable foothold through persistence, privilege use, credential abuse, discovery, lateral movement, command-and-control and exfiltration indicators without inventing missing steps.
method: establish a bounded incident time window and affected identities/assets
build a cross-source timeline using immutable evidence references
separate observed facts from inferred attack steps
identify credential hopping, unusual logon relationships and lateral movement chains
correlate process, DNS and network activity around suspicious authentication events
map supported behaviors to reviewed ATT&CK technique references when applicable
search for persistence, privilege escalation, credential access, defense evasion and exfiltration evidence
record contradicting evidence and missing telemetry before ranking hypotheses
emit the earliest supported entry point, affected path and current compromise scope only when evidence supports them
stop_conditions: evidence cannot distinguish compromise from benign administration
timeline continuity is insufficient to claim an attack path
required source provenance is missing or invalid
a requested conclusion would require inventing an unobserved step
